collection: GaN and AlN growth and material-property evidence
scope: Primary research for planning and subsequent parameter extraction. Literature evidence is not validation of the proposed chamber.
rights_note: Files were acquired from publicly accessible publisher, author, institutional, or arXiv locations for this project's reference collection. Public access does not establish a blanket redistribution license. Check each source's license before public redistribution.

sources.title: Gallium adsorption on (0001) GaN surfaces
sources.source_locator: Experimental procedure; Figs. 1-5; Table I. Saved published PDF has 9 pages; arXiv preprint has different pagination.
sources.supports: Separate Ga adlayer inventory and droplet regime; calibrated adsorption/desorption transients; Ga flux calibration by N-rich growth RHEED oscillations with stated sticking assumption.
sources.does_not_support: Direct conversion of arbitrary RHEED intensity to thickness or coverage; universal Arrhenius prefactors; transferring Ga-polar kinetics to other orientations.

sources.title: In situ GaN decomposition analysis by quadrupole mass spectrometry and reflection high-energy electron diffraction
sources.source_locator: Saved PDF pp. 2-5: Figs. 1-6, Eq. (3), and Conclusions.
sources.supports: Vacuum decomposition measurement by two diagnostics; effective loss depends on active-N excess; N-rich recapture suppresses loss while slightly Ga-rich loss resembles vacuum loss.
sources.does_not_support: Zero loss whenever nitrogen is on; one decomposition parameterization for all surfaces, coverages, or materials; treating the reported 3.1 eV apparent barrier as a complete rate law.

sources.title: Growth diagram and morphologies of AlN thin films grown by molecular beam epitaxy
sources.source_locator: Bibliographic lead corroborated by G11 reference 33 and later author publications; original full text not acquired.
sources.supports: Identifies the foundational AlN heteroepitaxy growth-diagram study to acquire.
sources.does_not_support: No numerical parameters or independently reviewed original-paper physics are extracted from this URL-only entry.
sources.unavailable_reason: Publisher page retrieval failed; no verified open original PDF acquired in this pass. Follow-up metadata download was interrupted by approval-service usage limit.

sources.title: Role of atomic nitrogen during GaN growth by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy revealed by appearance mass spectrometry
sources.source_locator: Saved PDF pp. 1-3, experimental source/aperture setup and Figs. 2-4.
sources.supports: Appearance mass spectrometry and growth calibration distinguish supplied atomic N from incorporated N; measures power/flow dependence for an identified source.
sources.does_not_support: Assuming all RF sources have the same active-species fractions, unit sticking, universal power-to-flux map, or zero ions.

sources.title: Plasma-assisted Molecular Beam Epitaxy of N-polar InAlN-barrier High-electron-mobility Transistors
sources.source_locator: Protocol: Effusion Cell Ramp and Flux Calibration; nitrogen-source setup; Ga deposition/desorption; rotation-triggered RHEED acquisition.
sources.supports: Concrete calibration workflow and repeat BFM readings; explicit source-specific active-N flux; shutter and surface-inventory transients.
sources.does_not_support: Extending project material scope to InAlN; transferring N-polar device recipe or instrument setpoints to proposed Ga/Al-polar equipment.
sources.unavailable_reason: Relevant primary web text reviewed; no PDF saved. Direct PMC requests intermittently presented a challenge; open-access locator retrieval was interrupted by approval-service usage limit.

sources.title: Plasma assisted molecular beam epitaxy of GaN with growth rates >2.6 µm/h
sources.source_locator: Publisher abstract and accessible sections Growth rate and Plasma source improvements; author-group bibliography. URL ending /2026 is an item identifier, not publication year.
sources.supports: Source geometry and aperture modifications change achievable rate; a measured RF-power/flow matrix is needed; accessible growth-rate discussion includes non-monotonic flow response.
sources.does_not_support: A 600 W source universally reaches a particular rate, or increasing flow always raises active-N delivery; base UHV guarantees no hydrogen incorporation.
sources.unavailable_reason: Publisher sections reviewed; no verified open original PDF acquired. Do not treat abstract/HTML as digitized figure data.

sources.title: Heat capacity of alpha-GaN: Isotope effects
sources.publication: Physical Review B 72, 075209; saved arXiv preprint cond-mat/0503522v1
sources.source_locator: Experimental method; Sec. IV; Figs. 4-5. Saved preprint has 17 pages.
sources.supports: Single-crystal wurtzite GaN heat-capacity measurements over 20-1400 K; distinguishes measured Cp from computed Cv and isotope effects.
sources.does_not_support: AlN, Si, SiC, sapphire, carrier or heater properties; unlimited extrapolation beyond the measured temperature interval.

sources.title: Thermal conductivity of crystalline AlN and the influence of atomic-scale defects
sources.publication: Journal of Applied Physics 126, 185105; saved arXiv version includes supplement
sources.source_locator: Sec. II experimental method; Fig. 4(a) measured conductivity at 100-400 K; Figs. 4(b), 5 and supplement distinguish modeled boundary/defect effects.
sources.supports: AlN material quality and thickness affect conductivity; measured uncertainty and independent room-temperature TDTR check; bulk/film distinction.
sources.does_not_support: Using room-temperature bulk conductivity for a thin defective growing film at 1000-1473 K; all plotted model curves are measured data.

sources.title: Thermal conductivity of AlN, GaN, and AlxGa1-xN alloys as a function of composition, temperature, crystallographic direction, and isotope disorder from first principles
sources.publication: arXiv:1910.05440v1; preprint, journal publication not established in this audit
sources.source_locator: Figs. 1-3, Tables I-III and analytical model; calculation range 100-1000 K; saved PDF has 16 pages.
sources.supports: A/c anisotropy, temperature and isotope/composition dependence from first principles; candidate property prior and cross-check.
sources.does_not_support: Measured chamber properties, measured film conductivity, or validated continuation to 1473 K; peer-reviewed status is not established.
sources.filename_note: The acquisition filename contains 2020; bibliographic year is 2019. Filename retained to preserve the existing download log.

sources.title: Molecular beam homoepitaxy of N-polar AlN: Enabling role of aluminum-assisted surface cleaning
sources.source_locator: Results and Methods: comparison of samples with/without Al-assisted cleaning; structural/polarity characterization. Saved 16-page file contains article plus appended material.
sources.supports: Initial oxide/surface preparation can change regrown polarity and interface structure; clean versus unclean paired specimens are a useful experimental design.
sources.does_not_support: Assigning polarity solely from the intended recipe; transferring N-polar substrate kinetics to Al-polar or patterned GaN without evidence.

sources.title: Surface control and MBE growth diagram for homoepitaxy on single-crystal AlN substrates
sources.source_locator: Saved pp. 2-4; Figs. 2-3 (cleaning/desorption and Al-polar growth diagram); Fig. 5 (SIMS bulk/interface distinction); data availability statement.
sources.supports: AlN-specific adlayer/droplet growth regimes; reported thermocouple versus true surface-temperature distinction; interface contamination can persist despite low bulk impurity concentrations.
sources.does_not_support: A universal 700 C AlN process; numerical thermocouple settings transferred between machines; low bulk SIMS signal proving a contamination-free nucleation interface.

sources.title: Characterization of Sub-Monolayer Contaminants at the Regrowth Interface in GaN Nanowires Grown by Selective-Area Molecular Beam Epitaxy
sources.source_locator: Table 1 and Fig. 1 on p. 3; APT ambiguities/discussion on pp. 4-6; Conclusions.
sources.supports: Observed correlation between Al/O interface contamination and inversion domains in selective-area GaN nanowires; comparison of preparation histories; analytical limitations.
sources.does_not_support: Universal causal coefficients for planar device leakage or Si contamination; exact O coverage from ambiguous APT mass assignments; a 2024 publication date.
sources.date_note: Published in 2018; PMC manuscript became available in 2025. Neither archival date establishes a new publication year.
